Sandbox_LivingFellows_EncountersEnabled_: Allows new independent survivors to appear. Existing companions are never removed when this is disabled.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_EncounterFrequency: Controls the minimum real-time delay between independent survivor encounters.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_MaxCompanions_tool: Limits new recruitment and encounters. Lowering this value never deletes companions already stored in the save.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_CompanionNeedsRate: 0 disables natural hunger and thirst growth. 0.5 is the intended default; 1 matches the ordinary player rate.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_HouseholdSpawnsEna: Allows new barricaded households to appear. Existing households remain alive when this is disabled.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_HouseholdDailyChan: Chance checked on an eligible day after the household cooldown and distance rules are satisfied.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_MaxHouseholds_tool: Stops additional household spawning at this count. Lowering the value never removes households already saved.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_OddballsEnabled_to: Allows three unique strangers to appear near suitable places from day two. Existing strangers stay in the save when disabled.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_OddballEncounterDa: After this many in-game days, the next suitable unseen location may host a unique stranger. A lack of suitable places can delay the encounter.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_BanditCampsEnabled: Allows rare persistent hostile camps to appear from day four. Existing camps remain when this is disabled.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_BanditCampDailyCha: Chance checked once per eligible day. Successful camps observe a ten-day cooldown.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_MaxBanditCamps_too: Stops additional bandit camp spawning at this count. Lowering the value never removes camps already saved.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_UIOpacity_tooltip: Adjusts the background opacity of the companion menu while preserving visibility of approaching threats.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_ShowCompanionNames: Draws a subtle first-name label above recruited companions that the player can currently see. Names yield to speech and are never shown through walls.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_IntrusiveThoughtsE: Allows occasional odd, dark, or morbid asides during calm travel and camp time. Companions never act on these thoughts.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_ProfanityEnabled_t: When disabled, companion lines with rough language use their clean alternatives.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_DiariesEnabled_too: Some companions carry a diary and, in quiet moments, write short entries about things that really happened to them. Existing diaries and their pages are never removed when this is disabled.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_DiaristChance_tool: Chance, decided once per recruited companion and saved, that the companion keeps a diary. Changing it never re-decides companions that already had their chance.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_ExpeditionDestinat: All nearby includes buildings inferred from map data, even if you have not visited them. Known only lists buildings whose interiors your character has seen. Destinations still need a reachable route before departure.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_NicknamesEnabled_t: Allow companions to bring, earn, and use nicknames. Existing saved nicknames remain when this is turned off.
Sandbox_LivingFellows_FamousNamesakes_to: A very small number of new survivors may share an exact name with a fictional zombie story character. Off by default.
